results.name: test windows are up
hotkey starts the UI and shows the panel above all windows
first-run wizard waits while the panel is open
dragging across the grid places the window exactly
during the drag a non-interactive preview shows the exact target and the window has not moved yet
panel closes after placing and focus returns to the window
first-run wizard appears after the panel closes and saves on Finish
arrow keys, Shift+arrows and Enter place the window
Esc closes the panel without moving the window
Alt+= / Alt+Shift+= change columns / rows and the size is kept
Shift+drag places the window and keeps the panel open
command palette 'left half' snaps the previously focused window
recovery dialog shows the plan and restores the snapshot
Fractile UI windows are flagged as own and never offered as targets
tapping Alt keeps the 20x20 subdivision for a plain drag, and the half-cell selection lands exactly
panel-local shortcut (Ctrl+Left) snaps while the panel is open and does nothing once it is closed
with reset on open, a grid changed with Alt+= is back to the default 6x6 next time
closing and reopening the panel straight away keeps the UI running and the panel open
when the target closes with the panel open, the panel stays (with a notice), a drag places nothing and no other window moves
relaunching from the app menu shows the panel for the focused window; no second UI stays running
UI logged no Python errors during the run
